concertdef_sbom_workflow.overview: This workflow guides the generation of ConcertDef SBOM files from vulnerability scan reports. ConcertDef is IBM Concert's Application SBOM format (v1.0.2) used to describe software applications, their components, dependencies, services, and deployment environments.

step.title: Understand the Request
step.description: Parse user input to identify what needs to be generated

actions.action: Identify the application name and version
Determine which scan reports are available
Understand the target environment(s) if specified
Check if business/organizational information is provided

step.title: Locate and Analyze Scan Reports
step.description: Find and examine all available vulnerability scan reports

tools.tool: list_files - Find scan report files in the workspace
search_files - Search for specific patterns in reports

type.name: generic
type.approach: Analyze structure and extract component information

step.title: Extract Component Information
step.description: Parse scan reports to identify components and their relationships
step.critical_note: IMPORTANT: When extracting component information from scan reports, you MUST use the component name from the scan report's metadata as the component name in the ConcertDef SBOM. This is essential for Concert to properly associate vulnerability scans with SBOM components.

component.extract: Image name, tag, digest, base image
component.component_name_rule: CRITICAL: Component name must NOT include the image tag. Extract only the image name portion, excluding any tag (e.g., ":latest", ":v1.0"). Example: From "digisic/digitalbank:latest" use only "digisic/digitalbank"
component.cyclonedx_extraction: For CycloneDX format: Extract from metadata.component.name Example: "digisic/digitalbank" from metadata.component.name (tag excluded)

format.name: CycloneDX
format.example: From: {"metadata": {"component": {"name": "digisic/digitalbank", "type": "container"}}} Use: "digisic/digitalbank" as the component name in ConcertDef SBOM

format.name: Trivy
format.name_extraction_rule: Strip the tag portion (everything after and including the colon) from the image name
format.example: From: {"ArtifactName": "myapp:latest"} Use: "myapp" as the component name (tag ":latest" excluded)

format.name: Grype
format.name_extraction_rule: Strip the tag portion (everything after and including the colon) from the image name
format.example: From: {"source": {"target": {"userInput": "myapp:v1.0"}}} Use: "myapp" as the component name (tag ":v1.0" excluded)

phase.name: structure_creation
phase.description: Create the base ConcertDef SBOM structure

step.action: Create root structure with required fields

step.details: - timestamp: Current ISO 8601 timestamp - type: "application" (for Application SBOM) - component: Application name and version - business: Organization name and business units
Top-level component is typically a "build" type containing: - Container images (blueprint-container) - Code repositories (blueprint-code) - Libraries (blueprint-library)

phase.name: component_population
phase.description: Populate components from scan report data

step.for_each: Container image found in scan reports
step.critical_requirement:
MUST extract the component name from the scan report's metadata, but EXCLUDE the image tag. For CycloneDX: Use metadata.component.name without tag (e.g., "digisic/digitalbank") For Trivy: Use ArtifactName without tag (strip everything after ":") For Grype: Use source.target.userInput without tag (strip everything after ":")
The image tag should be stored separately in the "tag" field, NOT in the component name. This ensures Concert can match vulnerability scans to SBOM components correctly.
step.example: From scan report with "myapp:v1.2.3": - name: "myapp" (tag excluded) - tag: "v1.2.3" (stored separately) - uri: "registry.example.com/myapp:v1.2.3"

step.for_each: Repository identified in scan reports or context

step.description: Link components to their dependencies (services, code repos, etc.)

step.required: timestamp, type, component (with name and version)

step.description: All bom-ref values must be unique across the SBOM
All refs in dependencies must point to existing bom-refs
Ensure valid JSON syntax and proper nesting

phase.name: documentation
phase.description: Create documentation about the generation process

step.include: Scanner type, version, scan date, files analyzed
Number and types of components, sources of information
Missing information, inferred values, environment mappings
How to upload to IBM Concert, validation steps

phase.name: upload_to_concert
phase.description: Upload generated SBOM and scan reports to IBM Concert using MCP tools
phase.critical_prerequisite: Before uploading, verify that component names in the ConcertDef SBOM match the component names in the vulnerability scan reports. This is REQUIRED for Concert to properly associate vulnerability data with SBOM components.

step.validation: - Check that SBOM component names match scan report component names - For CycloneDX scans: SBOM component name must match metadata.component.name - For Trivy scans: SBOM component name must match ArtifactName - For Grype scans: SBOM component name must match source.target.userInput - If mismatch found, regenerate SBOM with correct component names

step.details: After generating the ConcertDef SBOM file, upload it to IBM Concert: - Use the concert MCP server's upload_application_sbom tool - Provide the file path to the generated SBOM JSON file - Verify successful upload from the response

step.tool: use_mcp_tool with upload_image_scan, upload_code_scan, or upload_vm_scan
step.required_parameters: - file_path: Path to the scan report - application_name: Name of the application in Concert - scanner_name: Scanner that generated the report (grype, trivy, snyk, etc.) - metadata.application_version: Version of the application
step.details: Upload the original vulnerability scan reports to Concert: - Use the appropriate upload tool based on scan type - MUST include application_name parameter (matches SBOM metadata.component.name) - MUST include application_version in metadata - Include scanner_name (grype, trivy, snyk, etc.) - Add optional metadata (scan date, environment, image name, etc.) - Verify successful upload from the response
step.example: For a Grype scan of "digisic/digitalbank": - application_name: "digibank" (or full name from scan) - scanner_name: "grype" - metadata.application_version: "2.1.0" (from scan or SBOM) - metadata.image_name: "digisic/digitalbank"

completion_criteria.criterion: All required ConcertDef v1.0.2 fields are present
All components from scan reports are included
bom-ref values are unique and properly referenced
SBOM is ready for upload to IBM Concert
SBOM has been successfully uploaded to Concert (if requested)
Scan reports have been uploaded to Concert (if requested)

scenario.name: missing_scan_reports
scenario.action: Ask user to provide scan report files or locations

scenario.name: unrecognized_format
scenario.action: Analyze structure and attempt to extract component information
Ask user for clarification if needed

scenario.name: incomplete_information
scenario.action: Ask user for critical missing information
